quotes.text: In places like Michigan, nobody can pay more for their electricity bill. It is already off the charts. Our data centers need to be required, with no wiggle room, to have their own source of energy in a closed-loop system where they can't access any of our water, especially here in the Great Lakes.

Across the country, Americans are seeing the results as data centers are built in their own neighborhoods, often with little to no local input or control. Washington is giving handouts to big tech companies while American families are drowning. I hear that word in my district more than any other.
Tax cuts need to go to families, not data centers. We absolutely should not cut health care and food assistance for children and seniors to pay for tax giveaways to corporations.

President Trump is meeting with President Xi tomorrow to talk about AI. Here’s what needs to happen:

As the U.S. competes with China to lead the world on AI, we need protections for people’s jobs, safety, & opportunities.

That only works if it's on a global scale. This summit is the time to be tough on China & establish universal guardrails to protect Americans’ security & pocketbooks.

As the U.S. and China compete to lead the world on artificial intelligence, leaders must agree on common-sense regulations that protect people's jobs, safety, and opportunities. That only works if it happens at a global scale. President Trump needs to use this summit to be tough with President Xi, making sure we have a universal set of rules for the future of AI that protect Americans' security and pocketbooks.
